public_family_records.public_type: theta in {theta_0,theta_1}, with o=o_theta; this symbolic record is instantiated separately for each public type
public_family_records.member_parameter_or_selector: a Borel probability lambda_theta on the finite set of k-subsets K of the named weak states
public_family_records.member_generator: draw K from lambda_theta; propose x_j=beta*(1-beta*o_theta)/m iff j in K, x_j=0 otherwise, and retain P_I(o_theta)=1-k*beta*(1-beta*o_theta)/m
public_family_records.necessary_and_sufficient_membership_rule: lambda_theta is any probability on k-subsets; every supported proposal is minimal and passes; no other passing or rejecting proposal is a best reply because P_I(o_theta)-beta^2*o_theta>0
public_family_records.strategy_by_type: the publicly known type theta uses the member generator; there is no hidden countertype strategy in this public game
public_family_records.weak_vote_strategy: after every feasible proposal, weak j votes yes iff x_j>=beta*(1-beta*o_theta)/m, including equality by T^Y
public_family_records.belief_system: posterior mass one on public theta after every history
public_family_records.continuation_rule: after rejection use the literal M/S-selected symmetric representative N7-PUB-M-R1-T0-INCLUDE for theta_0 and N7-PUB-M-R1-T1-INCLUDE for theta_1
public_family_records.payoff_by_type_and_identity: H receives P_I(o_theta); in a passing realization weak j receives x_j; after any rejected proposal the date-A continuation vector is beta times the cited N7 R1 vector
public_family_records.outcome_distribution: lambda_theta pushes forward to immediate passage with H with probability one; the named coalition varies with K and the anonymous payment multiset is fixed
public_family_records.atomic_binder: B_AR_M_INCLUDE(theta,lambda_theta,C_M_INCLUDE_theta^MS) binds the same proposal law, complete votes, degenerate belief, literal continuation, payoffs and outcome law
public_family_records.selection_status: all current named-coalition lotteries lambda_theta retained; M/S selects only the continuation
public_family_records.refinement_status: PBE plus pure as-if-pivotal weak voting and T^Y; no proposal tie-break
